keySentence: True dignity cannot be taken away by poverty.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Sara lost her father and her fortune in a single devastating day. She was moved from a warm room to a cold attic immediately after. She had to work as a servant for the very woman who ran her school. The wealthy girls laughed at her torn clothes and her servant's duties. But Sara stayed calm and continued to speak kindly to everyone around her. She never lowered herself to cruelty even when cruelty was shown to her. She knew that a person's real worth had nothing to do with their bank account. True dignity cannot be taken away by poverty.
facts.Word cards: dignity = 품위 / within = 내면에서 / poverty = 가난 / taken away = 빼앗기다
